exposure: Time period: Pre-pandemic (October 2019-December 2019) vs. During the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic (March 2020-May 2020)
cohort: Pregnant women at three tertiary health care institutions in Nigeria
finding: The overall C-section rate during the first wave of COVID-19 was significantly lower than the prepandemic period, but there were higher rates of postdatism, fetal distress, emergency C-section, and postpartum anemia.
